scope: DOM节点连接状态检测与孤儿事件过滤
content: The read-only isConnected property of the Node interface returns a boolean indicating whether the node is connected (directly or indirectly) to a Document object.
conclusion: Node.isConnected 只读布尔属性指示节点是否直接或间接连接到 Document 对象。用于闭包监听器中快速验证节点是否仍在文档树中，已被移除的孤儿节点事件直接忽略。
